change.title: pr-36882-flat
change.description: Add rolling-updates feature flag and compatibility framework
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: CAUTION says the Operator fails without `rolling-updates`, but no operator code checks the feature
findings.body: The new CAUTION says that without the `rolling-updates` feature "the Keycloak Operator will fail". The operator code in this checkout never checks that feature. `UpgradeLogicFactory.create` (operator/src/main/java/org/keycloak/operator/upgrade/UpgradeLogicFactory.java:35-42) chooses `RecreateOnImageChangeUpgradeLogic` when no strategy is set, and `AlwaysRecreateUpgradeLogic` for `Recreate`. Neither path reads `features.enabled`. Nothing in operator/src/main calls the `update-compatibility` CLI either. The same page documents the `<not set>` default as working, and the diff's own test `UpgradeTest.createInitialDeployment` returns early without enabling the feature when the strategy is null. As written, users are told to enable a preview feature that the operator does not need today. Either describe what actually breaks, for example that `update-compatibility` or future rolling logic needs it, or drop the claim. This also applies to callout <1> in the YAML example, which presents the feature as required for the `Recreate` strategy.

findings.title: New exit codes 3 and 4 are not asserted
findings.body: This PR renumbers `RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` from 4 to 3 and adds `FEATURE_DISABLED = 4`. The docs promise both values for scripts. `testFeatureNotEnabled` only checks the error text, not that the exit code is 4. `testWrongVersions` (lines 96-106) only checks the message, not that the exit code is 3. A regression in the code mapping would pass these tests. Note that the file is not in this PR's diff; the gap is in the tests that cover the changed behaviour. Add `assertEquals(4, ...)` and `assertEquals(3, ...)` on the CLI results.

findings.title: Recreate exit code changes 4 -> 3 (behavioural change for existing scripts)
findings.body: `RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` changes from 4 to 3. This matches what update-compatibility.adoc already documented (3 = recreate), so the code now agrees with the docs. Any pipeline that was written against the old code value 4 will now read 4 as "feature disabled" instead of "recreate required". The command is preview, so this is probably acceptable. It is worth a note in the release notes or upgrading guide.

contracts.action: `update-compatibility metadata|check` is gated on the new `rolling-updates` preview feature and exits with code 4 when it is disabled
contracts.equivalent_path: Existing path: `printPreviewWarning(); validateConfig(); ...; picocli.exit(result.exitCode())` in the same `run()` methods (UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java:51-57, UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.java:51-55)
contracts.before_after: Before, the command ran unconditionally. Now it prints an error and calls `picocli.exit(FEATURE_DISABLED)` before the preview warning and before `validateConfig`, so a missing `--file` is not reported when the feature is off. Both commands return right after the exit call, in case `exit` does not terminate the JVM (in test launch mode `Picocli.exit` does not call System.exit, see Picocli.java:203-206).
contracts.visible_effect: stderr shows "Unable to use this command. The preview feature 'rolling-updates' is not enabled." and the process exit code is 4. The docs table documents code 4.
contracts.failure_mode: `includeRuntime()` is true for both commands, so the Profile is initialised before `run()`. With the feature off, `run()` returns normally after the exit call, so no further work happens.

contracts.action: The operator test and custom image are changed to enable `rolling-updates`
contracts.equivalent_path: Existing path: `KeycloakDistConfigurator.configureFeatures` maps `FeatureSpec.enabledFeatures` to the `features` option (operator/src/main/java/org/keycloak/operator/controllers/KeycloakDistConfigurator.java:121-124)
contracts.before_after: The old test set an empty `UnsupportedSpec`. The new one sets `features.enabled=[rolling-updates]`, but only when `updateStrategy != null` (the early return at line 106). The custom image is built with `--features=rolling-updates` and started with `--optimized`, because the operator adds that arg for custom images.
contracts.visible_effect: The operator does not read the feature itself (UpgradeLogicFactory.java:35-42), so the test outcome does not depend on it.
contracts.failure_mode: No failure found. The doc claim that the operator "will fail" without the feature is not backed by operator code (see finding).

summary: The feature gate is implemented consistently in both CLI commands. The renumbered exit codes now match the existing docs table. One finding concerns the docs. The new CAUTION says the Operator fails without `rolling-updates`, but no operator code checks the feature. The default and `Recreate` paths run without it. I also suggest asserting the new exit codes 3 and 4 in `UpdateCommandDistTest`. The change from 4 to 3 for recreate is noted as info only. I did not build or run anything.
